Questions, answered

Understand AI visibility before investing in it.

What is AI visibility?+

Whether AI engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini bring up your brand — and how favourably — when buyers ask for recommendations in your category.

What does the free audit include?+

A one-time snapshot: your visibility score, the buyer prompts where you never appear, the competitors taking your place and the first gaps to close.

How is the paid platform different from the audit?+

The audit is a diagnosis. The platform keeps watching — it monitors your prompts on a schedule, tracks how answers change and turns each new gap into a prioritized action plan.

These are the short versions. Read the full Pallix FAQ on AI visibility, audits and markets or compare Pallix pricing plans for brands and agencies.
